post.summary: Marks a work item as completed.

get.summary: Returns a page of work items.
Returns a single work item.
Counts per industry; a record with several industries counts in each. dateFrom and dateTo are required.
Counts per department (default) or municipality (needs a department filter). dateFrom and dateTo are required.
Counts per value of the industry, department, status and source filters, each ignoring its own filter. Without dates, the last 365 days.
Totals of the records matching the filters, each counted once. Without dates, the last 365 days.
Counts and totals per day, week or month (default), with zero for periods without records. dateFrom and dateTo are required (3 years at most).
The contracting entities with the most records (limit 1-50, default 10). dateFrom and dateTo are required.
When each SECOP dataset last synced successfully.
Searches processes and contracts together.
Returns the scraped enrichment of a SECOP II process and its status.

post.summary: Queues the scraping of the public SECOP II page of a process (documents, schedule, offers deadline).
post.description: Off by default (503 Scraping.Disabled). 503 Scraping.HostBlocked carries blockedUntil when the portal refused the scraper. Poll GET on the same route for the result.

get.summary: Whether the optional scraping is on, whether the portal is blocked, and the last 24 hours of outcomes.
Exports the processes matching the filters as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM, ';'). Paging is ignored.
Returns one process with its related contracts.
Searches procurement processes. Direct contracting is left out unless competitiveOnly=false.
Returns one ingestion run with its progress counters.
Lists ingestion runs, newest first.

post.summary: Queues a SECOP sync run (backfill, incremental, reconcile or refresh-open).

get.summary: Returns the sync watermark of every dataset.
Exports the contracts matching the filters as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM, ';'). Paging is ignored.
Returns one contract.
Searches signed contracts.

post.summary: Maps a SECOP spelling of a place to a DIVIPOLA municipality.

delete.summary: Removes the industry mapping of a UNSPSC prefix.

put.summary: Maps a UNSPSC prefix (2, 4, 6 or 8 digits) to an industry.

get.summary: Returns the DIVIPOLA departments.
Returns the industries with the UNSPSC prefixes mapped to each one.
Returns DIVIPOLA municipalities, optionally filtered by department and name fragment.
Returns the locations the normalizer could not resolve, most frequent first.

post.summary: Reloads departments and municipalities from DIVIPOLA (datos.gov.co).
Saves a search of the current user; with a frequency, new matches are emailed.
post.description: The filters are validated like GET processes / GET contracts (400). 422 SavedSearch.LimitReached past Alerts:MaxSavedSearchesPerUser, 422 SavedSearch.VerifiedEmailRequired without a verified email, 409 SavedSearch.NameTaken for a repeated name.

get.summary: Lists the saved searches of the current user.

delete.summary: Deletes a saved search and its delivery history.

get.summary: Gets a saved search of the current user (404 for anyone else's).

put.summary: Replaces the name, filters and frequency of a saved search; its kind never changes.

get.summary: Runs a saved search: the same page GET processes or GET contracts returns for its filters.
Lists the alert emails of a saved search, newest first.

post.summary: Pauses the alert of a saved search.
Resumes the alert of a saved search.

get.summary: One-click unsubscribe of an alert email (anonymous; the signed token authorizes it).
get.description: Sets the frequency of the saved search to none. Answers text/html: 200, or 400 for an invalid token.
